t: This is St George's Fields, a former burial ground of St George's, Hanover Square, lying between Connaught Street and Bayswater Road. The ground was deconsecrated and sold off by the Church Commissioners in the 1970s, and housing was built on it by the Utopian Housing Association. Among those buried here is Dido Elizabeth Belle, born into slavery, the daughter of a naval officer, Sir John Lindsay, and an enslaved woman, Maria Belle. Lindsay brought her to England, and she was raised by his uncle, Lord Mansfield, and his wife. Also buried here are the collector Welbore Ellis Agar and Jane Kelsall.
